fact: By end March 2024 Togo's two operators had 3.55 million mobile money users (Tmoney 2.16 million, Flooz 1.4 million), and ARCEP's survey found 75% of users cited the lack of Tmoney-Flooz interoperability as a challenge.
title: As of March 2024, Togo Had 7.3 Million Mobile Users, Including 3.55 Million Mobile Money Users
